input: # Keywords and value words as identifiers, as protoc admits them (its
# tokenizer has one identifier class): the inputs of docs/design/alt-explosion.md
# section 12, its two controls, the case-fold rows of section 4, and a few
# more shapes the keyword-first statement ordering has to get right.
# a field named by a keyword
syntax = "proto3"; message M { int32 message = 1; }
# a field named by a keyword
syntax = "proto3"; message M { int32 option = 1; }
# a field named by a keyword
syntax = "proto3"; message M { int32 optional = 1; }
# a field named by a keyword
syntax = "proto3"; message M { int32 map = 1; }
# a field named by a keyword
syntax = "proto3"; message M { int32 to = 1; }
# a field named by a keyword
syntax = "proto3"; message M { int32 max = 1; }
# a field named by a keyword
syntax = "proto3"; message M { int32 stream = 1; }
# a field named by a keyword
syntax = "proto3"; message M { int32 reserved = 1; }
# a message named by a keyword
syntax = "proto3"; message service { int32 a = 1; }
# a package segment that is a keyword
syntax = "proto3"; package foo.message.bar;
# a type segment that is a keyword
syntax = "proto3"; message M { foo.option.Bar x = 1; }
# an enum value named by a keyword
syntax = "proto3"; enum E { max = 0; }
# an rpc named by a keyword
syntax = "proto3"; message M {} service S { rpc stream (M) returns (M); }
# an option named by a keyword
syntax = "proto3"; option message = 1;
# a field named by an edition-2024 keyword
edition = "2024"; message M { int32 export = 1; }
# a field named by a value word
syntax = "proto3"; message M { int32 true = 1; }
# a field named by a value word
syntax = "proto3"; message M { int32 false = 1; }
# a field named by a value word
syntax = "proto3"; message M { int32 null = 1; }
# an enum value named by a value word
syntax = "proto3"; enum E { true = 0; }
# control: a type whose first segment is a visibility keyword
edition = "2024"; message M { local.pkg.T x = 1; }
# control: an identifier that begins with a value word
syntax = "proto3"; message M { int32 truth = 1; }
# case-fold: an enum named like a keyword
syntax = "proto3"; enum Edition { EDITION_UNKNOWN = 0; }
# case-fold: names that fold to keywords
syntax = "proto3"; message Message { int32 Service = 1; int32 MAX = 2; }
# a field and a nested message both named message
syntax = "proto3"; message M { int32 message = 1; message message { int32 m = 1; } }
# protoc commits to a nested message at `message` and refuses this; the union reads a field of type `message` (see AGENTS.md)
syntax = "proto3"; message M { message message = 1; }
# a label needs a type and a name
syntax = "proto3"; message M { optional message = 1; }
# edition-style reserved names that are keywords
syntax = "proto3"; message M { reserved message, option; }
# a oneof member needs a type
syntax = "proto3"; message M { oneof o { option = 1; } }
# an option named message, a oneof and its member named option
syntax = "proto3"; message M { option message = true; oneof option { int32 option = 1; } }
# enum values named by statement keywords
syntax = "proto3"; enum E { option = 1; reserved = 2; }
# an rpc named returns
syntax = "proto3"; message M {} service S { rpc returns (M) returns (stream M); }
# an rpc named stream, streaming both ways
syntax = "proto3"; message M {} service S { rpc stream (stream M) returns (stream M); }
# a streamed type named stream, both ways
syntax = "proto3"; message stream {} service S { rpc M (stream stream) returns (stream stream); }
# a map value type named message
syntax = "proto3"; message M { map<string, message> m = 1; }
# visibility modifiers beside names that are the same words
edition = "2024"; export message M { int32 export = 1; local enum E { local = 0; } }
# a group named group, with a field named to
syntax = "proto2"; message M { optional group group = 1 { optional int32 to = 1; } }
# the descriptor.proto field names
syntax = "proto3"; message M { int32 syntax = 1; int32 edition = 2; int32 package = 3; int32 weak = 4; int32 public = 5; int32 import = 6; }
